requirements.label: Credit rules
requirements.title: Minor credit total and upper-division credits

rule.text: Completion of the minor requires 21 credits. Nine or more credits for the minor must be upper division.
rule.reason: Program-wide credit total and upper-division credit minimum are not expressible with the available rule types.

requirements.sourceText: Completion of the minor requires 21 credits. Nine or more credits for the minor must be upper division.

policies.sourceText: All letter-graded courses for the minor in Digital Arts must be passed with a letter grade of C or higher.

notes.text: Program Advisor: Izumi Ashizawa, Izumi.Ashizawa@stonybrook.edu. Pre-approval is required for appropriate 487 projects and 488 internships, and for topics courses (ARS 390, ARS 491, ARS 492, ARH 308, ARH 400, ARH 490).
No more than six credits from any internship (488) may be applied to the minor. No more than three credits from ARS 487 may be applied to the minor.
